messages:
Priya Nair: heads-up — customer reported inconsistent client-visible codes for quota-related failures. sometimes 429, sometimes 409. they rely on status to trigger retry vs quota UI.
Sam Chen: ah. which endpoint / scenario?
Priya Nair: hosted API, multi-tenant path, but we also saw same for a Dedicated route where we do routing fallback to cheaper model.
Amanda Lee: 409 is currently used for 'tenant budget exhausted' in some routing layers, 429 is generic rate limit. that's a bug for clients that expect retryable=true for 429 only.
Darren M: rough timeline: this came up during a customer onboarding where their SDK shows 'quota exceeded' modal only for 409 and falls back to retry for 429 -> bad UX.
Kate B: quick question: do we want to standardize on 429 for transient/per-tenant rate and 409 for hard budget limit (non-retryable)? or flip?
Sam Chen: proposing: 429 = transient throttling (retry-after supported), 409 = capacity/budget collision (non-retryable, surface console link).
Priya Nair: +1 on semantics. also need machine-friendly fields in payload so SDKs can decide without parsing message text. e.g. `retryable`, `quota_type`, `route_hint`.
Amanda Lee: agreed. payload shape suggestion:
```json
{
  "status": 429,
  "code": "rate_throttle",
  "retryable": true,
  "retry_after": 2.3,
  "route_hint": "burst_pool"
}
```
Priya Nair: and for budget exhausted:
```json
{
  "status": 409,
  "code": "tenant_budget_exhausted",
  "retryable": false,
  "console_url": "https://console.redwood.ai/account/usage",
  "help_text": "Contact your account admin or increase Dedicated capacity."
}
```
Darren M: we also need telemetry labels for SLO/rollouts: `error_bucket` and `routing_variant` so console dashboards can aggregate correctly.
Kate B: backlog items: SDK changes, runtime routing tags, console copy + link, and API contract doc update. which team picks which?
Sam Chen: runtime (eng-runtime) will change status mapping + add `route_hint`. Eng-platform (this channel) owns the API contract PR and console copy. Devex to update SDKs.
Amanda Lee: small catch: some older Private deployments have a legacy mapping that hardcodes 409 for any quota. Need migration plan and a feature flag to opt-in to new contract.
Priya Nair: can we add a header for compatibility? `X-RW-Error-Contract: v2` so proxies and SDKs can detect.
Sam Chen: nice. header + body fields. makes gateway upgrades safer.
Infra Bot: scheduled job created: ticket INF-7234 — "error-contract: v2 header and payload fields" assigned to eng-runtime.
Darren M: rollout plan proposal:
- alpha: internal SDK + console behind feature flag (2 weeks)
- beta: opt-in customers, add header on hosted only (3 weeks)
- GA: flip default + announce + migration doc (4 weeks)
Kate B: add analytics event: `client_error_classified` with props {status, code, retryable, route_hint}. Product wants to show a per-customer trendline for budget hits.
Priya Nair: also add example console copy for 409 badge: "Budget exceeded — upgrade reserved capacity or reduce request rate. View usage" (link). Keep phrasing consistent across Dedicated/Hosted/Private docs.
Amanda Lee: SDK change: expose an enum `ErrorKind { RetryableThrottle, TenantBudget, NonRetryableOther }` mapped from `code`. Avoid relying on status alone.
Sam Chen: note for docs: include sample responses for edge cases (mixing headers, missing retry_after). Add migration FAQ.
Priya Nair: can someone spin up the API contract PR skeleton? I can draft console copy + telemetry event spec.
Darren M: I'll take the PR skeleton and tests for mapping. assigning to self.
Sam Chen: ping @Amanda Lee and @Priya Nair for review when ready.
Kate B: should we add a console banner when a tenant hits budget, linking to docs? product says yes.
Priya Nair: yes. UX: banner + persistent notice in usage page + optional webhook alert.
Amanda Lee: ok — I'll coordinate with product.
Infra Bot: INF-7234 updated by Darren M: moved to In Progress.
Priya Nair: thanks. leaving checklist here:
- [ ] API contract PR (eng-platform)
- [ ] runtime mapping + header (eng-runtime)
- [ ] SDK enum + console link exposure (devex)
- [ ] console badge + banner copy (product + console)
- [ ] telemetry event + dashboard (observability)

Sam Chen: small dev note: include stable `code` strings (snake_case) and register them in `internal/error_catalog.md`.
Darren M: will add tests that simulate fallback routing where we used to rewrite 429->409; ensure we preserve `retryable=false` semantics for budget hits.
Priya Nair: good. if no objections I'll open the contract draft tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Kate B: :thumbsup:
Amanda Lee: :+1:
Sam Chen: :+1:
